issues.display_title: Issue #1832: Proxy DELETE /copilot/admin/actions/{slug} to GoThru RAG Service
issues.main_description_html:
Overview

Implement the admin proxy endpoint in GoThru-API-New to delete an action document by slug from gothru-rag (DELETE /actions/{slug}).

Upstream Target

  • Service: gothru-rag
  • Target Route: DELETE /actions/{slug}
  • Upstream Auth: Requires header X-Admin-Key: {GOTHRU_RAG_ADMIN_KEY}

Endpoint Specification

  • Method & Route: DELETE /copilot/admin/actions/{slug}
  • Auth: middleware('auth') + Admin permission check
  • Headers:
    • Authorization: Bearer <user_token>

Response (200 OK)

Standard response wrapped via ResponseEnvelopeHelper::responseMessages:

{
  "statusCode": 200,
  "data": {
    "messages": "Action deleted successfully",
    "slug": "how-to-manage-tours",
    "status": "deleted"
  }
}

Scope & Tasks

  1. Route: Register DELETE /copilot/admin/actions/{slug} under admin route group in routes/copilotRoutes.php.
  2. Controller & Action: Implement App\Http\Controllers\Copilot\Admin\DeleteActionController and action App\Actions\Copilot\DeleteActionAction.
  3. Admin Request: Forward DELETE request with slug path parameter and X-Admin-Key header.
  4. Error Handling: Handle 404 Not Found if action file does not exist in RAG storage, and 500 if upstream deletion fails.
  5. Tests: Add unit/feature tests for successful deletion, 404 handling, and admin authorization verification.

Acceptance Criteria

  • Endpoint restricted to authorized admins.
  • Action file corresponding to slug is deleted and triggers index reload in RAG.
  • Returns 404 if the action slug is not found.
  • Feature/unit tests pass.

Result

  • Status: Completed & Merged into main via PR #1839.
  • Implemented Components:
    • Route: DELETE /copilot/admin/actions/{slug} in routes/copilotRoutes.php with auth middleware.
    • Controller: App\Http\Controllers\Copilot\Admin\DeleteActionController@handle.
    • Action: App\Actions\Copilot\DeleteActionAction@execute.
    • DTO: App\DTOs\Copilot\DeleteActionDto.
    • Validator: App\Validators\Copilot\DeleteActionValidator.
    • Domain Service: App\Services\Copilot\GoThruRagService::deleteAction.
    • Exception Mapping: COPILOT.ACTION_NOT_FOUND mapped to HTTP 404.
    • Docs: docs/v2/copilot/admin-delete-action.md.
  • Verification:
    • PHPUnit test suite passed (63 tests, 162 assertions).
    • Live HTTP curl E2E tested: 401 on missing token, 403 on non-admin token, 404 on non-existent slug, and 200 on super-user deleting action file on disk and re-indexing in gothru-rag.

issues.display_title: Issue #1841: feat(templates): Add type property to menu items in Template Match API V2
issues.main_description_html:
Ref: #1825

Background

In GET /v2/templates/menu/match (#1825), the API currently returns each menu node with:

  • name
  • pano_id
  • sub_menus

However, menu items in overlay.json (widgets.menu.panos) have distinct types (pano, text, link, hotspot). Because type is currently omitted, items such as text and link fallback to pano_id: 0 without any identifier to determine what kind of menu node they are.

Scope & Tasks

  1. Update Parser (OverlaysClass::parseMenuNodeV2):
    • Add type field to the returned item structure: 
      $item = [
    'type'      => $node['type'] ?? (isset($node['pano']['id']) ? 'pano' : 'text'),
    'name'      => $name,
    'pano_id'   => isset($node['pano']['id']) ? (int)$node['pano']['id'] : 0,
    'sub_menus' => []
];
  2. Validation & Filtering (GetMatchV2::filterMenuRecursive):
    • Ensure nodes with type !== 'pano' (e.g. text, link) are retained even if pano_id === 0 and they have no sub-menus.
  3. Automated Tests:
    • Update tests/Class/OverlaysGetMenuV2Test.php to assert the presence and correctness of the type field (pano, text, link, hotspot).
    • Run test suite to ensure all assertions pass.
  4. Documentation:
    • Update docs/v2/templates/get-template-menu-match-v2.md schema to include type.

Expected Response Schema (GET /v2/templates/menu/match)

{
  "statusCode": 200,
  "data": {
    "messages": "Data retrieved",
    "template_type": "personal",
    "template_name": "Nested Menu Template",
    "menu": [
      {
        "type": "pano",
        "name": "Pano 1",
        "pano_id": 47915512,
        "sub_menus": [
          {
            "type": "pano",
            "name": "Pano 1.1",
            "pano_id": 47915516,
            "sub_menus": []
          }
        ]
      },
      {
        "type": "text",
        "name": "Just Teks",
        "pano_id": 0,
        "sub_menus": []
      },
      {
        "type": "link",
        "name": "Just Link",
        "pano_id": 0,
        "sub_menus": []
      },
      {
        "type": "hotspot",
        "name": "Hot Hot",
        "pano_id": 47915512,
        "sub_menus": []
      }
    ],
    "gallery": []
  }
}

Acceptance Criteria

  • Every menu node in V2 includes strictly: type, name, pano_id, sub_menus.
  • Nodes of type text and link without children are preserved and not filtered out by panorama ID validation.
  • Backward compatibility: V1 (GET /templates/menu/match) remains unaffected.
  • Unit & integration tests pass with 100% green.

Implementation & Verification Result

1. Code Changes

  • OverlaysClass::parseMenuNodeV2: Added type field mapped directly from overlay.json ($node['type']), defaulting to 'pano' if pano.id exists, or 'text'.
  • GetMatchV2::filterMenuRecursive: Added non-pano check (in_array($item['type'], ['text', 'link'], true)) so standalone text and link items without children are not discarded by DB pano validation.

2. PR & Commits

  • Pull Request: #1842
  • Commit: a4709fefa (feat(templates): support menu item types in template match api v2 (#1841))
  • Documentation: docs/v2/templates/get-template-menu-match-v2.md

3. Automated & Live Verification

  • Unit Tests (tests/Class/OverlaysGetMenuV2Test.php):
    • test_get_menu_v2_returns_nested_sub_menus — passed
    • test_get_menu_v2_supports_explicit_menu_types — passed (asserts pano, text, link, hotspot)
    • test_get_menu_v2_falls_back_to_en_when_active_lang_missing — passed
    • test_get_menu_v2_handles_empty_or_missing_panos — passed
    • Result: 4 tests, 37 assertions passed.
  • Integration Tests (tests/Actions/Templates/GetMatchV2ActionTest.php):
    • test_filter_menu_recursive_preserves_non_pano_types_and_valid_panos — passed
    • Result: 3 tests, 13 assertions passed.
  • Live Local Verification:
    • Tour uUQY70H1: Multi-level nested menus (pano, text, link) validated successfully (HTTP 200).
    • Tour eCznJUSe: Mixed single-level menu (text, link, hotspot) validated successfully (HTTP 200).
